title: RBI (Commercial Banks – Responsible Business Conduct) Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026
description: <cite index="53-3,53-4,53-5">The RBI issued a comprehensive framework governing loan recovery practices by commercial banks, introducing stricter rules for recovery agents, enhanced borrower safeguards and tighter oversight of technology-based recovery mechanisms, coming into effect from January 1, 2027. The revised guidelines replace earlier instructions with a single framework covering recovery of loan dues, engagement of recovery agencies and borrower rights.</cite>
